title: Corn, twenty-nine, the tray shared
logline: September, a week early in the box: one paper tray of corn and two forks, Gully's hand and a thin one, from above, the counter. Twenty-nine. The first year the tray is shared on the page.

panels.composition: From above: a paper tray of buttered corn on a wooden counter with two forks in it, a heavy hand and a thin hand reaching from opposite sides.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from above, a paper tray of buttered corn on a wooden counter with two forks and a heavy hand and a thin hand reaching from opposite sides, no words
